faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFDC Executive (Digital/Social Media) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 29-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Executive (Digital/Social Media) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Please check the official notification for any age relaxation rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive (Digital/Social Media) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month, all inclusive.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Executive (Digital/Social Media) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Executive (Digital/Social Media) position in the National Film Development Corporation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis, as indicated by the advertisement number.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only through the online mode for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Film Development Corporation located?
faq.answer: The National Film Development Corporation is located in Delhi.
